scenes.headline: How two KV heads pay for a 131K window
scenes.sub: MiniCPM5-2B: a plain Llama whose long context fits in 8GB.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Newt! MiniCPM5-2B is a small open model with a hundred and thirty-one thousand token window. Here's what makes that affordable.

scenes.label: The trick
scenes.text: Its 16 query heads share just 2 key-value heads, so the cache is 8 times smaller.
scenes.say: It's a stock Llama. But its sixteen query heads share just two key-value heads, so the cache it keeps is eight times smaller.

steps.say: Each new token still makes sixteen query heads, in each of forty-two layers.
But only two key and value heads, and those are what get cached, for the life of the request.
Each group of eight query heads reads the same cached key and value. The compute doesn't move.
The memory does: it drops with the KV-head count. Eight to one is aggressive, even for this trick.

scenes.title: What one token costs to remember
scenes.text: 42 layers x 2 KV x 128 x K+V x 2 bytes
scenes.say: Here's what one token costs to remember.

parts.note: every layer keeps its own cache

parts.say: A hundred and twenty-eight numbers each.

parts.note: a key and a value, 2 bytes each at f16
parts.say: A key and a value, two bytes apiece. Forty-three thousand and eight bytes a token.

scenes.title: KV cache at 131,072 tokens
scenes.note: a real RTX 3060 report implies 5.64 GB
scenes.say: At the full window that's five point six four gigabytes. With sixteen KV heads it would be about forty-five, which fits on no consumer card.

items.say: Pretraining stretches the context, up to five hundred and twelve K.
Mid-training runs at thirty-two K, then a hundred and twenty-eight K.
Reinforcement learning branches that into sixteen expert teachers.
And on-policy distillation merges them back into one model.

scenes.text: Not cheap because the model is small: cheap because the cache is small.
scenes.say: So the window isn't cheap because the model is small. It's cheap because the cache is small, and that's one config field.
To recap: two KV heads, a small cache, and sixteen teachers distilled into one.
